scripts.text:
[Pandit chacha]
Hahaha~
It is special day, comes only one time in a year.
If you see little adventurers around you send to me~
I will give the special gift.
scripts.translation:
[潘迪特大叔]
哈哈哈~
今天可是个特别的日子，一年只有一次哦。
看到小小冒险者的话，就叫他们来找我吧~
我有特别的礼物要送给他们。

scripts.text:
[Pandit chacha]
Hahaha~
You are a baby adventurer not little adventurer.
When you more grow up, come back again. hahaha.
scripts.translation:
[潘迪特大叔]
哈哈哈~
你还是个婴儿冒险者，可不是小小冒险者哦。
再长大一点才来吧，哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Pandit chacha]
Hahaha~
Welcome, little adventurers!
Today is special day, isn't it~?
I would like to give the small gift to little adventurer...
What about you? Do you want to take it?
scripts.translation:
[潘迪特大叔]
哈哈哈~
欢迎你，小小冒险者！
今天是个特别的日子，对吧~？
我想送你一份小礼物...
怎么样，要收下吗？

scripts.text: No. I will take it later.

[Pandit chacha]
That's too bad.... hum...
I gathered some stuffs from far a way world to make it....
Whenever come back again if you want it...
scripts.translation:
[潘迪特大叔]
真可惜...嗯...
我可是从遥远的世界收集了材料，才做出这份礼物的...
想要的话，随时回来找我吧。

scripts.text:
[Pandit chacha]
Look. This is a child Potion.
The weight is just 1 but recover much HP.
If you want to get more, bring the 1 Wedding Bouquet and 1 Witherless Rose.
scripts.translation:
[潘迪特大叔]
看。这是儿童药水。
它的重量只有1，但能恢复很多HP。
如果想要更多，请带来1个捧花和1朵永恒玫瑰。

scripts.text:
[Pandit chacha]
Ahha!!
You have remembered my beautiful composition.
You did good work.
Could you give me 1 Wedding Bouquet and 1 Witherless Rose?
scripts.translation:
[潘迪特大叔]
啊哈！！你还记得我的妙方啊，真不错。
能给我1个捧花和1朵永恒玫瑰吗？

scripts.text:
[Pandit chacha]
If you are not prepared yet, call me when you ready.
scripts.translation:
[潘迪特大叔]
如果还没准备好，等准备好了再叫我。

scripts.text:
[Pandit chacha]
Hahaha~
Oh~ you get it.
Here, I will exchange to the 50 child potion.
Once you get this 50 child potion, I won't give any more.
scripts.translation:
[潘迪特大叔]
哈哈哈~
哦~东西都带来了。
来，给你换50瓶儿童药水。
领完这50瓶，可就不能再领了哦。

scripts.text:
[Pandit chacha]
Little adventurers, you should bring the 1 Wedding Bouquet and 1 Witherless Rose.
If you bring these stuffs I will exchange them for child Potion.
scripts.translation:
[潘迪特大叔]
小小冒险者，带1个捧花和1朵永恒玫瑰来吧。
带齐这两样，我就给你换儿童药水。

scripts.text:
[Pandit chacha]
Hahaha~
Are you enjoying children week~?
scripts.translation:
[潘迪特大叔]
哈哈哈~
儿童周玩得开心吗~？
